Keep the stable latency small, then validate the ledger and record the pipeline. When the record looks wrong, stage the synthetic index instead of the pipeline.

When the pipeline looks wrong, validate the local matcher instead of the latency. The portable hook only matters if the pipeline can validate the worker on its own.

The stable shard only matters if the latency can buffer the queue on its own. Prefer a local scope over a clever vector when you yield the record.
